provenance: Chromosome lengths and gene spans are GRCh38 primary-assembly values (Ensembl/NCBI). Gene spans are visualisation extents, not minimal transcripts. Curated hotspot positions are mapped proportionally inside the gene span; the HGVS c. notation is authoritative, not the pixel position.

genes.name: Hemoglobin subunit beta
genes.summary: Beta-globin. The HbS allele collapses deoxygenated hemoglobin into polymers.

phenotypes.label: Sickle cell trait
phenotypes.note: Usually asymptomatic; confers partial protection against Plasmodium falciparum malaria.

phenotypes.label: Sickle cell anemia
phenotypes.note: Chronic hemolysis, vaso-occlusive crises, splenic sequestration.

hotspots.phenotype: Sickle hemoglobin polymerises when deoxygenated.

genes.name: CF transmembrane conductance regulator
genes.summary: cAMP-activated chloride/bicarbonate channel in epithelial apical membranes.

phenotypes.label: CF carrier
phenotypes.note: No disease; relevant for reproductive counselling.

phenotypes.label: Cystic fibrosis
phenotypes.note: Viscous mucus, bronchiectasis, pancreatic insufficiency, elevated sweat chloride.

hotspots.phenotype: CFTR fails quality control in the ER; little channel reaches the apical membrane.

genes.name: BRCA1 DNA repair associated
genes.summary: Scaffold for homologous-recombination repair of DNA double-strand breaks.

phenotypes.label: Hereditary breast/ovarian cancer predisposition
phenotypes.note: Lifetime risk is elevated but not deterministic; surveillance and risk-reducing options apply.

hotspots.phenotype: Truncated BRCA1 loses BRCT-domain function; HR repair is impaired.

genes.name: BRCA2 DNA repair associated
genes.summary: Delivers RAD51 to single-stranded DNA during homologous recombination.

phenotypes.label: Hereditary breast/ovarian/pancreatic cancer predisposition
phenotypes.note: Penetrance differs by variant and family history.

hotspots.phenotype: Loss of the RAD51-binding region blocks strand invasion.

genes.name: Tumor protein p53
genes.summary: Transcription factor that arrests the cycle or triggers apoptosis after DNA damage.

phenotypes.label: Li-Fraumeni syndrome
phenotypes.note: Early-onset sarcomas, breast cancer, adrenocortical carcinoma, brain tumours.

hotspots.phenotype: DNA-contact mutant p53; dominant-negative over the wild-type tetramer.
Destabilised p53 core domain; rapid degradation.

genes.name: Low density lipoprotein receptor
genes.summary: Clears LDL particles from plasma by receptor-mediated endocytosis.

phenotypes.label: Familial hypercholesterolemia (heterozygous)
phenotypes.note: LDL-C roughly doubled; premature atherosclerosis.

phenotypes.label: Familial hypercholesterolemia (homozygous)
phenotypes.note: LDL-C 4-6x; coronary events in the first decades.

hotspots.phenotype: Impaired LDL binding in the EGF-precursor homology domain.

genes.name: Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9
genes.summary: Secreted protease that routes the LDL receptor to lysosomal degradation.

phenotypes.label: Hypercholesterolemia (gain of function)
phenotypes.note: Less LDLR recycling, higher plasma LDL.

phenotypes.label: Very low LDL-C (loss of function)
phenotypes.note: Naturally protective; the basis of PCSK9-inhibitor pharmacology.

hotspots.phenotype: Enhanced LDLR degradation (gain of function).

genes.name: Apolipoprotein E
genes.summary: Lipid transport protein; isoforms differ at residues 112 and 158.

phenotypes.label: APOE e4 carrier
phenotypes.note: Elevated late-onset Alzheimer risk; risk, not destiny.

hotspots.phenotype: APOE4 isoform; altered amyloid clearance and lipid handling.
APOE2 isoform; lower Alzheimer risk, higher type III hyperlipoproteinemia risk in homozygotes.

genes.name: Aldehyde dehydrogenase 2
genes.summary: Mitochondrial aldehyde dehydrogenase that clears acetaldehyde.

phenotypes.label: Alcohol flush / reduced acetaldehyde clearance
phenotypes.note: Flushing, tachycardia after small alcohol doses; increased oesophageal cancer risk with drinking.

phenotypes.label: Near-absent ALDH2 activity
phenotypes.note: Marked intolerance to alcohol; strong protective effect against alcohol dependence.

hotspots.phenotype: Lys504 enzyme assembles poorly; acetaldehyde accumulates.

genes.name: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase
genes.summary: Rate-limiting NADPH source protecting erythrocytes from oxidative stress.

phenotypes.label: G6PD deficiency
phenotypes.note: Episodic hemolysis after fava beans, sulfonamides, primaquine or infection.

phenotypes.label: G6PD carrier (mosaic)
phenotypes.note: X-inactivation gives two red-cell populations; usually mild.

hotspots.phenotype: Unstable enzyme; NADPH collapse under oxidative challenge.

genes.name: Phenylalanine hydroxylase
genes.summary: Converts phenylalanine to tyrosine using tetrahydrobiopterin.

phenotypes.label: PAH carrier
phenotypes.note: Unaffected; newborn screening relevant.

phenotypes.label: Phenylketonuria (PKU)
phenotypes.note: Phenylalanine neurotoxicity; prevented by dietary restriction started in infancy.

hotspots.phenotype: Misfolded PAH; residual activity under 5%.

genes.name: Methyl-CpG binding protein 2
genes.summary: Binds methylated CpG and recruits repressors; dosage-sensitive in neurons.

phenotypes.label: Rett syndrome
phenotypes.note: Regression of language and hand use after 6-18 months; mostly de novo in females.

phenotypes.label: Severe neonatal encephalopathy (males)
phenotypes.note: Most affected males do not survive without somatic mosaicism.

hotspots.phenotype: Truncated MECP2 loses the transcriptional repression domain.

genes.name: Huntingtin
genes.summary: CAG repeat expansion above ~36 repeats yields a toxic polyglutamine protein.

phenotypes.label: Huntington disease
phenotypes.note: Chorea, cognitive decline, psychiatric symptoms; anticipation with paternal transmission.

hotspots.phenotype: Mutant huntingtin aggregates; striatal neuron loss.

genes.name: Fragile X messenger ribonucleoprotein 1
genes.summary: CGG repeat; >200 repeats silence the gene through methylation.

phenotypes.label: Fragile X syndrome
phenotypes.note: Intellectual disability, macroorchidism, autistic features.

phenotypes.label: Premutation carrier
phenotypes.note: FXTAS/POI risk in carriers; expansion risk in offspring.

hotspots.phenotype: Methylated CpG island shuts off FMRP expression.

genes.name: Dystrophin
genes.summary: Links the actin cytoskeleton to the sarcolemma; absence causes membrane fragility.

phenotypes.label: Duchenne muscular dystrophy
phenotypes.note: Frame-disrupting deletions; progressive weakness, cardiomyopathy.

phenotypes.label: DMD carrier
phenotypes.note: Usually asymptomatic; occasional cardiomyopathy.

hotspots.phenotype: Out-of-frame deletion abolishes dystrophin.

genes.name: Amyloid precursor protein
genes.inheritance: autosomal dominant (rare early-onset AD variants); dosage sensitive
genes.summary: Membrane protein cleaved to Abeta peptides; extra copies raise Abeta load.

phenotypes.label: Early-onset Alzheimer disease (rare variants)
phenotypes.note: Missense variants near the secretase sites increase Abeta42/40.

hotspots.phenotype: Altered gamma-secretase cleavage raises Abeta42.

genes.name: Superoxide dismutase 1
genes.summary: Cu/Zn superoxide dismutase; misfolded variants are toxic to motor neurons.

phenotypes.label: Familial ALS (subset)
phenotypes.note: Gain-of-function toxicity, not loss of dismutase activity.

hotspots.phenotype: Destabilised SOD1 dimer aggregates in motor neurons.

genes.name: Dual specificity tyrosine phosphorylation regulated kinase 1A
genes.summary: Kinase that balances neural progenitor proliferation and differentiation.

phenotypes.label: Altered neurodevelopment
phenotypes.note: Overexpression in trisomy 21 is linked to reduced cortical neuron output in models.

genes.name: Cystathionine beta-synthase
genes.summary: Transsulfuration enzyme lowering homocysteine.

phenotypes.label: Classical homocystinuria
phenotypes.note: Thrombosis, lens dislocation, intellectual disability.

hotspots.phenotype: Reduced CBS activity; homocysteine accumulates.

genes.name: Collagen type VI alpha 1
genes.summary: Extracellular matrix collagen in skeletal muscle.

phenotypes.label: Bethlem myopathy spectrum
phenotypes.note: Contractures and proximal weakness; collagen VI disorders.

genes.name: Homeostatic iron regulator
genes.summary: Modulates hepcidin signalling; C282Y homozygosity causes iron overload.

phenotypes.label: Hereditary hemochromatosis
phenotypes.note: Iron deposition in liver, pancreas, heart; phlebotomy is curative if early.

phenotypes.label: HFE carrier
phenotypes.note: Usually no iron overload.

hotspots.phenotype: Loss of beta-2-microglobulin association; hepcidin deficiency.

genes.name: Serpin family A member 1 (alpha-1 antitrypsin)
genes.summary: Protease inhibitor protecting alveolar elastin from neutrophil elastase.

phenotypes.label: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (PiZZ)
phenotypes.note: Early emphysema, liver cirrhosis from polymer retention.

phenotypes.label: PiMZ carrier
phenotypes.note: Slightly reduced serum AAT; risk rises with smoking.

hotspots.phenotype: Z alpha-1 antitrypsin polymerises in hepatocytes.

genes.name: Tyrosinase
genes.summary: Rate-limiting enzyme of melanin synthesis.

phenotypes.label: Oculocutaneous albinism type 1
phenotypes.note: Absent melanin; photophobia, nystagmus, high UV sensitivity.

phenotypes.label: TYR carrier
phenotypes.note: Unaffected pigmentation.

hotspots.phenotype: Truncated tyrosinase; no melanin produced.

genes.name: Melanocortin 1 receptor
genes.summary: G-protein coupled receptor switching eumelanin to pheomelanin.

phenotypes.label: Red hair / fair skin phenotype
phenotypes.note: Increased UV sensitivity and melanoma risk.

hotspots.phenotype: Reduced cAMP signalling; pheomelanin dominates.

genes.name: Actinin alpha 3
genes.summary: Z-disc protein in fast-twitch fibres; the R577X null is common.

phenotypes.label: Alpha-actinin-3 deficiency
phenotypes.note: No disease; subtle shift toward endurance phenotypes in some cohorts.

hotspots.phenotype: Nonsense allele; no alpha-actinin-3 in fast fibres.

genes.name: Cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily D member 6
genes.summary: Polymorphic CYP450 enzyme handling ~25% of drugs.

phenotypes.label: Poor metaboliser
phenotypes.note: Reduced clearance of codeine, tramadol, tamoxifen and many antidepressants.

hotspots.phenotype: Aberrant splicing; non-functional enzyme.

genes.name: Epidermal growth factor receptor
genes.summary: Receptor tyrosine kinase driving proliferation when constitutively active.

phenotypes.label: EGFR-mutant tumour (somatic)
phenotypes.note: Sensitising L858R or exon 19 deletions respond to tyrosine-kinase inhibitors.

hotspots.phenotype: Kinase held in the active conformation; ligand-independent signalling.

genes.name: KRAS proto-oncogene
genes.summary: Small GTPase locked in GTP-bound state by codon 12 mutations.

phenotypes.label: KRAS-driven tumour (somatic)
phenotypes.note: Constitutive MAPK signalling; historically undruggable.

hotspots.phenotype: GTPase activity lost; downstream RAF/MEK/ERK constitutive.

genes.name: Major histocompatibility complex class I B
genes.summary: Antigen presentation; specific alleles drive drug hypersensitivity.

phenotypes.label: HLA-B*57:01 carrier
phenotypes.note: Abacavir hypersensitivity syndrome; screening is standard of care.

hotspots.phenotype: Abacavir binds the antigen-binding cleft and re-shapes presented peptides.

genes.name: Insulin
genes.summary: Beta-cell hormone regulating glucose uptake.

phenotypes.label: Neonatal diabetes (rare variants)
phenotypes.note: Proinsulin misfolding triggers beta-cell ER stress.

hotspots.phenotype: Mutant proinsulin misfolds; dominant-negative ER stress.

mutagens.name: Ethyl methanesulfonate (EMS)
mutagens.mechanism: Ethylates O6-guanine; replication pairs O6-ethyl-G with thymine, producing GC to AT transitions.

mutagens.name: N-ethyl-N-nitrosourea (ENU)
mutagens.mechanism: Alkylates thymine and adenine; the workhorse mutagen for mouse forward genetics.

mutagens.name: Methyl methanesulfonate (MMS)
mutagens.mechanism: N7-methylguanine and N3-methyladenine; depurination and replication blocks.

mutagens.name: Ultraviolet C (254 nm)
mutagens.mechanism: Cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers and 6-4 photoproducts; polymerase bypass inserts adenines, giving C to T and CC to TT.

mutagens.name: Aflatoxin B1 (CYP3A4-activated)
mutagens.mechanism: Epoxide forms N7-guanine adducts; depurination and GC to TA transversions, with a hotspot at TP53 codon 249.

mutagens.name: Benzene metabolites (quinones)
mutagens.mechanism: Reactive quinones cause oxidative lesions plus chromosome breaks, deletions and aneuploidy.

mutagens.name: Ionising radiation (gamma)
mutagens.mechanism: Direct strand breaks and clustered lesions; repair failure yields deletions and translocations.

mutagens.name: Colchicine (spindle poison)
mutagens.mechanism: Tubulin binding blocks spindle formation; cells exit mitosis with wrong chromosome numbers. No point mutations.

mutagens.name: 5-Azacytidine
mutagens.mechanism: Incorporated into DNA and traps DNMTs, causing demethylation and re-expression of silenced genes.
